initiatives.title: Duty-Bound Decision
initiatives.description: In July 2021, heavy rains in Konkan and Western Maharashtra led to a natural disaster. Understanding the seriousness of the situation and the social responsibility, the Mandal decided to provide essential supplies to the flood-affected people of Mahad and Chiplun regions.

initiatives.title: Free Distribution of Household Essentials
initiatives.description: Through a joint initiative of Chef Vikas Khanna’s Feed India and Lalbaug Public Utsav Mandal (Mumbaicha Raja), essential household items were distributed free of cost to the most needy members of the Mandal’s divisions.

initiatives.title: Important Decision for Members
initiatives.description: Due to the COVID-19 outbreak in 2020, the financial condition of the general public deteriorated. Understanding this, the Mandal took a significant step by not collecting any fees from members that year for Ganeshotsav.

initiatives.title: Chief Minister's Relief Fund
initiatives.description: In response to the appeal by Hon. Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray during the 2020 COVID crisis, Mumbaicha Raja Mandal donated ₹5,00,000/- to the Maharashtra Chief Minister’s Relief Fund.

initiatives.title: Help for Flood Victims in Western Maharashtra
initiatives.description: In August 2019, heavy rains caused flood-like situations in Kolhapur, Satara, Sangli, and other parts of Western Maharashtra. Many families lost their homes. In this tough time, the Mandal provided essential supplies worth up to ₹3,00,000/-.

initiatives.title: Kargil Relief Fund
initiatives.description: Apart from natural disasters, the Mandal is always at the forefront in times of national crisis. During the Kargil War, in response to the government's appeal, the Mandal contributed ₹1,00,000/- to the Kargil Relief Fund in support of our brave soldiers.

initiatives.title: Saree Distribution in Tribal Areas
initiatives.description: Every year during Navratri, devotees offer sarees to the Goddess of Lalbaug in gratitude. To honor womanhood, the Mandal distributes these sarees for free to women in tribal regions of the state.

initiatives.title: Rural Health Camps
initiatives.description: Along with Mumbai, the Mandal regularly organizes free health checkup camps in rural and remote areas. The Mandal takes pride in delivering medical services in hard-to-reach places such as Narsobachi Wadi, Sainik Takli, and Wangani in Thane district.
